#!/bin/bash

# Open Chrome with google.com
google_url="https://www.google.com"
google_chrome="google-chrome"

# Open text editor
text_editor="nano"

# Open file manager with the specified directory
file_manager="nautilus"
target_directory="[private-home]/Documents/llama.cpp"

# Launch all applications
$google_chrome $google_url &
$text_editor &
$file_manager $target_directory &

# Wait for all processes to complete
wait
